claim: The default shared-domain quota of AWS Managed Microsoft AD, which is the number of accounts that an individual directory can be shared to, is 25 for Standard Edition, 500 for Enterprise Edition and 125 for Hybrid Edition. Before the August 2025 increase the limits were 5 accounts (Standard) and 125 accounts (Enterprise).

qualifiers.scope: per directory (accounts it can be shared to)
qualifiers.condition: default quota; the quota page does not say whether it can be raised

evidence.quote: | Shared domains per Standard Microsoft AD \*\*\* | 25 |
| Shared domains per Enterprise Microsoft AD \*\*\* | 500 |
| Shared domains per Hybrid Microsoft AD \*\*\* | 125 |

AWS has increased the account sharing limits for AWS Managed Microsoft AD directory sharing, allowing customers to share their directories with significantly more AWS accounts. The Standard Edition limit has increased from 5 to 25 accounts, while the Enterprise Edition limit has expanded from 125 to 500 accounts.
The shared domain default quota refers to the number of accounts that an individual directory can be shared to.
